before.title: NCC 1983: planned ERA² and Logix Athena premiere
before.description: Present ERA² at 12 MHz target (16 MHz stretch), Athena 256 KiB / 5 MB HDD and Athena Server 1 MiB / 20 MB HDD. Both include 64 KiB graphics, one 5.25-inch DS/DD floppy and one network card. EEPROM BIOS plus 256 KiB directly executable AIONix2 system ROM. Protected multitasking, legacy ERA ABI, recoverable HDD storage, users and layered TUI are accepted design targets, pending implementation qualification. Conference runs 16–19 May in Anaheim; premiere does not certify volume shipments.
